query: What is the minimum distance of a Sprint, in kilometres?
note: Race distance clause has the same wording with 305 km

query: How long can a Sprint run before the leader is shown the end-of-session signal?
note: Race duration clause has the same wording with two hours

query: If Sprint Qualifying cannot take place, how is the grid for the Sprint decided?
note: Race grid clause has the same wording for Qualifying

query: How many minutes does the first period of Sprint Qualifying last?
note: SQ1 is 12 minutes, Q1 is 18 minutes

query: How long is the second period of Qualifying?
note: Q2 is 15 minutes, SQ2 is 10 minutes

query: What message is sent to all Competitors when the Safety Car is about to come in?
note: SAFETY CAR IN THIS LAP; the VSC clause sends VSC ENDING

query: When is the Virtual Safety Car used instead of the Safety Car?
note: B5.13.1 gives the Safety Car side of the contrast and is not needed for the answer

query: How many car lengths may separate the cars queued behind the Safety Car?
note: ten car lengths, twenty in poor visibility; the VSC clause has no gap rule

query: Can the Virtual Safety Car be used during free practice?
note: free practice is an LTCS, so the LTCS clause applies; the TTCS clause B5.12.1 has near-identical wording; needs definition APPENDIX B1#2

query: What can the stewards do about an incident during Qualifying?
note: Qualifying is an LTCS; the TTCS penalty list is the competing clause; needs definition APPENDIX B1#2; shares gold with X11

query: Where is a grid penalty for an incident in Sprint Qualifying served?
note: Sprint grid, not the Race grid; needs definition APPENDIX B1#2; shares gold with X10

query: How many free practice sessions are there at an Alternative Format Competition?
note: one session; the Standard Format clause lists three

query: How long is the second free practice session at a Standard Format Competition when extra tyres are provided for tyre testing?
note: answer is one sub-item (1.5 hours) of a long clause

query: Which set of tyres must a driver return within two hours of the end of the Sprint?
note: the set with the most Sprint laps; the Standard Format clauses have no Sprint rule but give a two-hour deadline after FP1
